capabilities: Display notes as cards on an infinite scrollable timeline canvas
Mark notes for timelines via timeline, date-start, and date-end frontmatter
Drag, resize, multi-select, and color-code timeline cards with undo/redo
Create and configure named timelines scoped to folders
Jump to notes or timeline cards via fuzzy-find and view commands
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff; the README lists supported date formats including extended BCE/CE ranges up to 20 billion years.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in view to see notes laid out chronologically on a timeline and rearrange their dates visually.
summary: Renders notes with date frontmatter as draggable, resizable cards on an infinite scrollable timeline canvas, with multiple folder-scoped timelines.
